helpers.name: Vlasov.W1ContOn_lt_top
helpers.one_line_math: For Vlasov solutions f, g with HasFiniteFirstMoment at each time t, the Wasserstein-1 distance wasserstein1 (f t) (g t) is strictly less than top (finite) at every t.

helpers.name: Vlasov.W1ContOn_integralContAt
helpers.one_line_math: For a Vlasov solution f with IsVlasovSolution gradW f, and any test function phi with ContDiff top and HasCompactSupport, the map t to integral phi d(f t) is continuous; this follows because IsVlasovSolution provides HasDerivAt for this integral, and HasDerivAt implies ContinuousAt.

helpers.name: Vlasov.W1ContOn_toRealContOn
helpers.one_line_math: Given LowerSemicontinuousOn and UpperSemicontinuousOn of t to wasserstein1 (f t) (g t) on [0, T], and finiteness from W1ContOn_lt_top, assemble ContinuousOn of t to (wasserstein1 (f t) (g t)).toReal by composing ENNReal.toReal (which is continuous on the finite ENNReal values).

axioms.name: MathlibTODO_W1ContOn_lscNarrow
axioms.statement_summary: t to wasserstein1 (f t) (g t) is LowerSemicontinuousOn [0, T] whenever f and g are narrowly continuous measure curves; follows from W1 being a sup of continuous functionals, but requires Mathlib KR duality for non-compactly-supported Lipschitz test functions.
axioms.one_line_math: The W1 distance, as a sup over 1-Lipschitz test functions of integral differences, is lower semicontinuous under narrow convergence of the measure arguments.

axioms.name: MathlibTODO_W1ContOn_uscNarrow
axioms.statement_summary: t to wasserstein1 (f t) (g t) is UpperSemicontinuousOn [0, T] for Vlasov solutions f, g with finite first moments; requires characteristic flow coupling argument and W1 triangle inequality under measure pushforward, not in Mathlib.
axioms.one_line_math: The W1 distance is upper semicontinuous along Vlasov solution curves, proved via the characteristic flow coupling: pairing particles of f and g via their common ODE flow gives a coupling whose cost controls W1 from above.

residual_glue.strategy: Invoke W1ContOn_toRealContOn which in turn uses the two MathlibTODO sub-axioms for LSC and USC plus the finiteness lemma W1ContOn_lt_top to conclude ContinuousOn of the toReal composition.
residual_glue.tactic_sketch: exact W1ContOn_toRealContOn gradW L hL f g hf hg hf_prob hg_prob T hT
